description: This file defines a jQuery UI widget called 'nestedSortable' for creating nested, sortable lists with expand/collapse functionality, supporting tree structures and multi-level nesting.

classes.name: mjs.nestedSortable
classes.description: A jQuery UI widget for nested sortable lists with tree structure support, expand/collapse, and multi-level nesting.

methods.name: _create
methods.description: Initializes the nestedSortable widget, sets up classes for tree nodes, and prepares the list for nested sorting.

methods.name: _destroy
methods.description: Cleans up the widget, removing data and restoring original state.

methods.name: _mouseDrag
methods.description: Handles the dragging logic, including rearrangement, expanding/collapsing nodes, and scrolling.

methods.name: _mouseStop
methods.description: Handles cleanup after dragging stops, including reverting invalid moves.

methods.name: _intersectsWithSides
methods.description: Determines if the dragged item intersects with the sides of other items, considering tree structure.

methods.name: _contactContainers
methods.description: Manages interactions with container elements during drag.

methods.name: _clear
methods.description: Clears temporary data and triggers relocation events.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the list into a query string representing the nested structure.

methods.name: toHierarchy
methods.description: Converts the list into a hierarchical JSON structure.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns a flat array of items with depth and parent information.

methods.name: _clearEmpty
methods.description: Removes empty nested lists and updates classes for tree nodes.

methods.name: _getLevel
methods.description: Calculates the nesting level of an item.

methods.name: _getChildLevels
methods.description: Calculates the maximum depth of child nodes.

methods.name: _isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if nesting/movement is allowed based on max levels and custom rules.
